contribution.position: My reliability position is unchanged. The perf report shows peak CPU at 93% against a 70% budget, which leaves almost no headroom. The incident log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter, both traced to retry storms, and a job near CPU saturation is where retries pile up and cascade. The QA turn cites 55% peak CPU, but the perf report says 93%, so that 'comfortably inside budget' claim does not match the artifact and should not offset this concern. The test report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) supports functional correctness. It does not show retry or backoff behavior under peak load. Evidence still needed: a peak-load test showing retries stay bounded, CPU back inside budget or the overage explicitly accepted by an owner, and confirmation that last quarter's retry-storm root causes are fixed or capped. Cost and runbook findings do not address this axis.
